limitations: One laptop, one model load, back-to-back sessions: other machines, a cold start or a busy GPU will differ.
Child replies are scripted and instant; INQUIRE, EVALUATE and CONTRACT make no model call today, so their numbers will grow when INQUIRE moves to the model after PP1.
